page_title: ANG 1-0 PAR | Angers v Paris FC 17/08/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The match has just finished.
90+7' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Herve Koffi intercepts the ball.
90+5' Nouha Dicko (Paris FC) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Francois Letexier who sees an offensive foul.
90+4' The corner is swung in but Paris FC can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

90+4' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
90+3' Carlens Arcus (Angers) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90+2' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Mathieu Cafaro, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
90' There will be a minimum of 6 min. of added time.
90' Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC) tests the keeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. His decent effort goes a whisker wide of the left post.
90' Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC) will take a free kick in a very promising position.
89' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Jacques Ekomie (Angers). A free kick is awarded to Paris FC.
87' Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC) launches a cross from the corner, but Herve Koffi is alert to thwart the effort.
85' The substitution is prepared. Nouha Dicko (Paris FC) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Timothee Kolodziejczak.
85' Alexandre Dujeux decides to make a substitution. Esteban Lepaul will be replaced by Prosper Peter (Angers).
85' The referee allows time for a substitution. Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) will be replaced by Marius Courcoul.
84' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 7:15. The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 2:7.
83' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) collects a wonderful lead pass and as he has a lot of space, smashes a terrific shot from long range. His shot goes painfully close to the crossbar!
80' Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC) gets the ball and drives a shot high over the bar from the edge of the area.
79' Julien Lopez (Paris FC) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Alimani Gory, but he can't get on the end of the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Angers.

76' Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Herve Koffi makes a comfortable save to stop the effort from flying into the middle of the goal.
72' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Jacques Ekomie (Angers) comes onto the pitch for Florent Hanin.
72' Substitution. Moses Simon makes way for Mathieu Cafaro (Paris FC).
71' Here is a change. Pierre-Yves Hamel is going off and Stephane Gilli gives the last tactical orders to Julien Lopez (Paris FC).
71' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
71' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) attempts to find Alimani Gory, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Angers will have a goal kick.
70' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
66' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Paris FC.
62' Here comes a substitution. Jim Allevinah (Angers) is brought on as a substitute for Lilian Raolisoa.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Lanroy Machine (Angers) comes onto the pitch so that Sidiki Cherif can be given a rest.
61' Stephane Gilli prepares a substitution. Lohann Doucet is replaced by Vincent Marchetti (Paris FC).
61' Stephane Gilli has decided to make a change. Alimani Gory (Paris FC) replaces Jean-Philippe Krasso.
61' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Paris FC was in an offside position.
60' None of the Paris FC players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
58' Timothee Kolodziejczak (Paris FC) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
57' Louis Mouton (Angers) makes a horror tackle on his opponent and receives a red card from the referee!
56' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Herve Koffi comes off the line to clear the ball away.
53' Esteban Lepaul (Angers) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area.
50' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
47' Moses Simon (Paris FC) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.

45+4' A neat pass is well received by Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC), who is lurking on the edge of the box and strikes the ball towards the left post, but the goalkeeper makes an incredible save to block his shot.

45+3' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) displays brilliant awareness inside the box to pounce on the rebound. From a difficult position he directs a header to the top of the net, but Herve Koffi pulls off a decent save to deny him.
45+2' Samir Chergui (Paris FC) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
45' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
44' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.

41' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) takes the resulting free kick from outside the box. He sends a nice cross into the box, but his intention is well anticipated by the goalkeeper who comes out to collect the ball.
40' Francois Letexier shows a yellow card to Yassine Belkhdim (Angers) for his blatant foul.
35' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
34' Paris FC failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

30' Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
30' A clumsy foul by Haris Belkebla (Angers) and Francois Letexier blows his whistle. Paris FC have a free kick.
29' The resulting set piece from Angers is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
29' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety. Now Angers have a corner.
25' The ref blows his whistle and we are going to have a so-called cooling break due to the high temperature.
23' Paris FC can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

22' A sweet pass finds Ilan Kebbal (Paris FC) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the top left corner. Herve Koffi is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The referee blows his whistle, Paris FC are awarded a corner kick.
20' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.
19' Francois Letexier blows his whistle. Mamadou Mbow (Paris FC) commits a foul after dangerous play.
15' Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) does his best to latch onto a cross into the box, but he can't get to the ball.
15' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Angers comes to nothing.

14' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the bottom left corner, but Obed Nkambadio is well positioned to make a comfortable save. Angers have a corner.
12' Francois Letexier blows his whistle and it's Lilian Raolisoa (Angers) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
10' Lohann Doucet (Paris FC) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

9' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Esteban Lepaul (Angers) scores with a brilliant shot into the bottom right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Jordan Lefort. The score is now 1:0.
8' Angers work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

7' Sidiki Cherif (Angers) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick strike towards the left side of the target that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a goal-line clearance. Good work from Angers as they win a corner.
5' Lohann Doucet (Paris FC) is penalised for holding. Francois Letexier signals a set piece.
5' Maxime Lopez (Paris FC) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

4' Jean-Philippe Krasso (Paris FC) picks up a pass and has an effort from the edge of the box, but Herve Koffi gets down to his right to keep it out. Paris FC force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
3' Lohann Doucet (Paris FC) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are on the pitch and Angers will have the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Francois Letexier.
Show lineups The starting XIs were already announced and you can go through them in the Lineups section.
